    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])

        return []

        return []
    
    # BFS setup
    queue = deque()
    queue.append((start[0], start[1], [start]))
    visited = set()
    visited.add((start[0], start[1]))

                visited.add((nr, nc))
                new_path = path + [(nr, nc)]
